title: SD-QA: Spoken Dialectal Question Answering for the Real World

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Word Error Rate (WER) and Question Answering (QA) F1-scores across 24 regional dialects of five languages, and measuring cross-dialect disparity using a generalized entropy index.
Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models between self-reported male and female speakers across different language varieties.
Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models across different speaker age groups (18-30, 31-45, 46-59) within different language varieties.
